notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Howlsquad Heavy.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.
